concept_name: LC Oscillations — The Circuit's Own Rhythm
source_book: NCERT Class 12 Physics, Ch.7 Alternating Current, §7.8 LC Oscillations — table-of-contents reference only; teaching authored from first principles, no sequence/example/figure imported. Seventh of 8 in the founder-reordered Ch.7 map (ac_voltage_resistor -> ac_voltage_inductor -> ac_voltage_capacitor -> phasors -> series_lcr_circuit -> ac_power_factor -> lc_oscillations -> transformer). This sim teaches the FREE (source-free) circuit: a capacitor is charged to V0 = 10.0 V and then the source is physically removed — a battery + two-position switch replace it — and the L-C pair oscillates by itself at its own NATURAL frequency omega0 = 1/sqrt(LC), never a source-imposed one. The current is MAXIMUM exactly when the charge is zero (the coil's inertia carries the motion through and recharges the plates reversed — the PRIMARY aha); the swing repeats at f0 = 0.25 Hz, the exact frequency the driven series_lcr_circuit favoured at resonance (the SUPPORTING aha — the circuit owned that number all along); the stored energy trades intact between the capacitor's electric field (1/2 q^2/C) and the inductor's magnetic field (1/2 L i^2), an ALL-WATTLESS exchange where nothing is ever spent; the whole motion is the exact electrical twin of a mass on a spring (q<->x, i<->v, L<->m, 1/C<->k, the coil playing the MASS because it resists change in current the way mass resists change in velocity); and real resistance damps the swing out, converting the ideal 'forever' into the honest reason every real LC ring fades. SCOPE: does not re-derive element behaviour, impedance, resonance, or power (settled in the six sealed siblings; one-clause callbacks only), does not treat driven/forced oscillation (that was series_lcr_circuit), does not treat mutual coupling or voltage transformation (deferred to transformer), and does not quantify the damped frequency/envelope algebra (alpha and omega_prime stay internal, never rendered — damping stays qualitative). Conceptual-only (no mode_overrides), EPIC-L-first (no epic_c_branches; the two genuine LC misconceptions — 'a discharged capacitor is a finished circuit' and 'an ideal oscillation must still run down' — are confronted inside EPIC-L via Rule 16a misconception_watch at exactly STATE_3 and STATE_5, each a wrong-consequence-first contrast beat, never a predict-pause). Routed to the NEW field_3d 'lc_oscillation' scenario (prefix lco_) — a clone-sibling of the sealed ac_power scenario (inherits its gauge/band/chrome-family CSS geometry) plus apparatus assets from the element scenarios; the genuinely NEW machinery is the battery+switch assembly (pose A = charging branch closed / coil branch open and bead-free; pose B = battery fully out, L-C loop closed through the switch blade), the charge-up transient, the free-oscillation closed-form phase clock (q(t)=Q0 cos(omega0 t), i(t)=-I0 sin(omega0 t)), the two-bar energy gauges in antiphase with NO heat bar until STATE_7, the mass-spring mechanical-analog inset, and the damping machinery. Zero edits to any sealed scenario (engine build tracked separately from this JSON authoring pass; renderer implementation is peter_parker:renderer_primitives scope, not json_author's). Handoff FROM ac_power_factor: inherits the energy-gauge instrument, the borrow-and-return vocabulary, and the settled wattless-current story as its own STATE_5 motivation. Handoff TO transformer (next, Ch.7 #8): delivers the completed chapter energy story ('an ideal L-C pair spends nothing; only R spends') and the settled chapter apparatus conventions — withholds mutual inductance, turns ratio, and voltage step-up/down entirely (transformer's own front door).

real_world_anchor.primary: Where a radio station's frequency is born. series_lcr_circuit taught how a receiver PICKS one station; this concept teaches where that station's frequency comes FROM. Inside every radio transmitter sits exactly this loop: charge sloshing between a coil and a capacitor at 1/(2*pi*sqrt(LC)) — the tank circuit. The broadcast frequency isn't typed in anywhere; it is BUILT, by choosing L and C so the tank's own natural rhythm becomes the station's frequency. A transmitter's LC tank chooses a rhythm; a receiver's LC circuit resonates to it — the chapter's two halves close into one story. Culture-neutral (radio and wireless transmitters exist everywhere), and physics-true at every depth — a real oscillator is exactly this tank plus a small feedback push that replaces what real resistance leaks away.
real_world_anchor.secondary: A struck tuning fork carries the same idea in miniature: hit it hard or soft, it rings at ITS OWN note, never yours — a bigger strike changes the loudness, never the pitch (the amplitude/frequency independence this sim's explore state lets a teacher discover directly). And the ring always fades, because energy leaks away as the fork's own internal friction — the LC loop is the same instrument, built in copper. Mains frequency, where it matters at all, stays neutral ('the mains frequency'), never a fixed regional number.

V0.name: Peak charging voltage — the value the plates are charged to before release

L.name: Self-inductance of the coil (off-grid default, F8 snap-on-first-drag pattern — fleet convention, same decimal as every sealed Ch.7 sibling)

C.name: Capacitance of the plates (off-grid default, F8 snap-on-first-drag pattern)

R.name: Resistance inserted into the loop. STATE_1-STATE_6 the loop is IDEAL (R does not exist yet, no slider row shown); STATE_7 scripted entry 0.0, eases to 2.0; STATE_9 fully live.

omega0.name: Natural angular frequency of the free circuit — depends ONLY on L and C, never V0 or R

omega0_deg_per_s.name: omega0 in deg/s — the degree-native rendering clock (fleet dialect, matches every sealed Ch.7 sibling)

theta.name: Instantaneous phase, the state's OWN clock (Rule 26). theta0=0 at EVERY guided state's entry — the free oscillation is periodic and history-free, so re-anchoring at each state's own entry is physically legitimate (never an accumulator).
theta.derived: theta = omega0_deg_per_s * t   [t = time since STATE ENTRY, or since a within-state sub-anchor, pure closed form]

f0.name: Natural frequency of the free circuit. Dual-labeled once at STATE_4 ('natural frequency f0'), bare thereafter (38d).

Q0.name: Peak (initial) charge on the plates — the SHM amplitude, sets q(t)'s ceiling

I0.name: Peak current — the SHM velocity amplitude, reached in MAGNITUDE exactly when q=0 (STATE_3 PRIMARY aha)

E_total.name: Total stored energy — CANONICAL PIN (binding). Computed by this ONE expression, in this exact left-to-right order, on EVERY surface: STATE_1 gauge-fill target, STATE_5 total-line marker, HUD E_total, half-split addends' base, STATE_7 E_R ceiling. NEVER a hand-copied literal, NEVER a re-ordered twin (0.5*C*100 lands 6.37, not 6.36), and NEVER the live sum E_C(t)+E_B(t) (which also lands 6.37 at some instants — verified: raw sum at t=0.50s toFixed(2) = '6.37', the pin toFixed(2) = '6.36'). This is a FIXED constant, computed once per state-apply, never a per-frame recomputation.

q_t.name: Instantaneous charge, undamped free oscillation (STATE_2 post-release through STATE_6, STATE_8 demo, STATE_9 when R=0)

i_t.name: Instantaneous current, convention i := dq/dt. Displayed on HUD/chips as |i_t| (magnitude, never a rendered minus sign). MAXIMUM in magnitude exactly when q_t=0.

E_C_t.name: Instantaneous electric-field (capacitor) energy — the green gauge

E_B_t.name: Instantaneous magnetic-field (coil) energy — the violet gauge

alpha.name: Damping constant (STATE_7 only; R=0 elsewhere gives alpha=0, no STATE_7 machinery runs). NEVER rendered as a numeral/symbol on canvas — damping stays qualitative (atomic claim).

omega_prime.name: Damped angular frequency — INTERNAL ONLY, never rendered on any text path. Real-valued only while R < R_crit (underdamped).

omega_prime_deg_per_s.name: omega_prime in deg/s — internal STATE_7 decay-leg clock only

phi_prime_deg.name: Small damping phase offset — INTERNAL ONLY, never rendered

R_crit.name: Critical resistance — at R>=R_crit the loop cannot complete even one swing. Equals the R slider's max (STATE_9 declared, unnarrated explore discovery). NEVER rendered.

t2.name: STATE_7 decay-leg sub-clock — time since the resistor-insert-complete instant. Zero before insertion completes.

q_damped_t.name: Instantaneous charge, damped free oscillation (STATE_7 decay leg only). Verified solution of the damped ODE (dE_mech/dt = -R*i^2 <= 0 exactly for this closed form).

i_damped_t.name: Instantaneous current, damped (i = dq_damped/dt, closed form, same resolved sign convention)

envelope_t.name: The decay envelope drawn on the strip rails (STATE_7) — replaces the guided +-Q0 dashed rails

E_R_t.name: Cumulative heat — computed AS THE COMPLEMENT of the SAME pinned E_total (never an accumulator). Ledger closes by construction; strictly non-decreasing since dE_mech/dt=-R*i^2<=0. Zero before insertion completes (loop still ideal).

E_C_charge_t.name: STATE_1 gauge-fill during the charge transient — reuses the SAME E_total pin, scaled, so it lands EXACTLY on the pinned 6.36 J at t=2.0s (never a second independent computation)

A_frac.name: Bead-excursion visual scale, calibrated to 0.30 at defaults, clamped for explore extremes

x_inset_t.name: STATE_6 mass-spring inset block position (fraction of x_max, an engine rendering constant), phase-locked to the SAME q(t) clock — never independently animated

formulas.energy_stored: E = 0.5*C*V0^2 — the initial energy tank, set by V0 and C alone, never by L (STATE_1)
formulas.undriven_shm: q(t) = Q0*cos(omega0*t), i(t) = dq/dt. Derived from L(di/dt)+q/C=0 <=> d^2q/dt^2 = -q/(LC) (STATE_2-STATE_6 the closed form; STATE_8 the derivation)
formulas.current_from_charge: i(t) = dq/dt = -I0*sin(omega0*t) — displayed as |i(t)|; MAX in magnitude exactly when q=0 (STATE_3 PRIMARY aha)
formulas.natural_frequency: f0 = 1/(2*pi*sqrt(LC)) — depends ONLY on L and C (STATE_4 SUPPORTING aha result; derived at STATE_8)
formulas.energy_ledger: E_C(t) = q(t)^2/(2C), E_B(t) = 0.5*L*i(t)^2, E_C(t)+E_B(t) = E_total exactly at every instant (undamped) — the address changes, the total never does (STATE_5)
formulas.shm_correspondence: q <-> x (displacement), i <-> v (velocity, i=dq/dt exactly mirrors v=dx/dt), L <-> m (inertia), 1/C <-> k (spring constant); omega0 = sqrt(k/m) <-> 1/sqrt(LC) (STATE_6)
formulas.damped_decay: q(t) = Q0*e^(-alpha*t)*cos(omega_prime*t), alpha = R/(2L); underdamped iff R < R_crit = 2*sqrt(L/C); E_R(t) = E_total - E_C(t) - E_B(t) (STATE_7)
formulas.derivation_chain: L*(di/dt) + q/C = 0 [KVL, source-free, i:=dq/dt] -> d^2q/dt^2 = -q/(LC) [SHM signature] -> omega0 = 1/sqrt(LC) -> f0 = 0.250 Hz [sealed decimals] (STATE_8)

constraints: E_C(t) + E_B(t) = E_total at every instant when R=0 (ideal, undamped) -- energy is conserved, only its address changes; the STATE_5 total line is a FIXED constant, never a live sum.
|i(t)| is maximum exactly when q(t)=0, and zero exactly when |q(t)|=Q0 -- current and charge are a quarter cycle apart (the SHM velocity-displacement relation), never in phase.
The undamped natural frequency omega0 = 1/sqrt(LC) depends ONLY on L and C -- never on V0 or R. R sets the DECAY rate alpha=R/2L, not the ideal frequency.
For R < R_crit = 2*sqrt(L/C) the loop is underdamped and continues to oscillate while decaying; at R >= R_crit the loop cannot complete even one swing.
E_total = 0.5*C*V0^2 is set entirely by the charging condition (V0) and C -- never by L (L only shapes HOW the energy trades between forms, never how much there is).
Amplitude (V0, hence Q0, I0) and period (T0, hence f0) are independent knobs -- changing V0 rescales the swing without changing its rhythm (the isochronism of ideal SHM).

STATE_1.title: A charged capacitor is a full energy tank — sitting still

scene_composition.text: Fill the tank — then remove the source

tts_sentences.text_en: Watch the plates fill — a battery drives charge onto them while the coil's branch stays open.
Ten volts builds up, and six point three six joules packs into the electric field.
Nothing moves through the coil yet — all the energy just sits still, waiting.
Now, remove the battery from the circuit completely.

STATE_2.title: With no source at all, current flows — the stored field drives it

scene_composition.text: charge q falling, current i rising
The draining charge seems to be the engine

tts_sentences.text_en: The switch throws — the battery leaves the circuit completely, and the loop closes on itself.
With no source at all, current starts flowing — driven only by the charge stored in the field.
Watch the plates empty as the current climbs — the draining charge seems to be driving everything.

STATE_3.title: PRIMARY aha — at zero charge the current is maximum

scene_composition.text: The coil won't let the current die

tts_sentences.text_en: As the charge nears zero, a ghost freezes beside the circuit — asking if the current stops too.
Watch the real circuit answer: right at zero charge, the current hits its fastest — two full amps.
The coil won't let a flowing current die — it drives the charge through and reloads the plates backward.

misconception_watch.belief: An empty (fully discharged) capacitor means the circuit's current has stopped too — q = 0 means i = 0.
misconception_watch.visual_counter: The dimmed ghost pose (beads stopped, chip 'q = 0 -> i = 0?') latches beside the live loop, then is struck at the actual zero-charge crossing while the real beads run at their fastest (i = 2.00 A, q = 0.00 C), the coil's energy gauge tops out, and the plate glyphs re-appear flipped in polarity.
misconception_watch.one_line_fix: The charge is empty but the motion is full — the coil's inertia keeps the current flowing and reloads the plates backward.

STATE_4.title: SUPPORTING aha — the swing repeats at its own natural rhythm

scene_composition.text: The circuit's own frequency, all along

tts_sentences.text_en: The trace docks and draws a clean wave — charge climbing, falling, and climbing again.
Crest to crest, the swing repeats every four seconds — a rhythm of its own.
That's zero point two five hertz — no source is setting this pace, only the coil and the plates.
That number was never the source's.

STATE_5.title: PIVOT — the energy only changes address, never spent

tts_sentences.text_en: Two gauges take over — plates in green, coil in violet, breathing in exact antiphase.
The total line never dips — six point three six joules, always, with no heat bar anywhere.
At the half-swing point, three eighteen and three eighteen still close to six thirty six.
Nothing is spent — it only changes address.

misconception_watch.belief: An oscillation must spend some energy every cycle — even an ideal, resistance-free LC loop should slowly run down.
misconception_watch.visual_counter: The two energy gauges trade in perfect antiphase under a total line that never dips, with no heat bar anywhere on screen, closing exactly at the half-split instant: 3.18 J + 3.18 J = 6.36 J.
misconception_watch.one_line_fix: Nothing is spent — the energy only changes address between the field and the coil; only real resistance can make it leave, which is STATE_7's story.

STATE_6.title: The exact mechanical twin — the coil is the mass

scene_composition.text: L is the mass — inertia, not spring

tts_sentences.text_en: A block on a spring docks beside the circuit, locked to the same clock.
Its position mirrors the charge exactly, and the current joins the trace as its velocity.
The block moves fastest through the middle, just like the current did.
The coil plays the mass — it's the charge count that swings, not electrons.

STATE_7.title: Real resistance drains the swing — the oscillation decays

scene_composition.text: Every real coil leaks energy as heat

tts_sentences.text_en: A small resistor slides in — watch its dial climb from zero to two ohms.
The swing starts shrinking inside a fading envelope — each pass carries a quarter of the last.
A warm bar climbs — the energy that once just traded now leaks as heat.
Real coils leak — that's why rings fade.

STATE_8.title: Derivation: source-free KVL to the natural frequency

tts_sentences.text_en: Start from the loop's voltage law — inductor voltage plus capacitor voltage equals zero.
That rearranges into simple harmonic motion — acceleration exactly opposite to displacement.
Solving gives the natural frequency — one over the square root of L times C.
Plug in our numbers, and it lands at zero point two five zero hertz.

STATE_9.title: Explore — the free circuit under the teacher's hands

scene_composition.text: Drag V₀ · L · C · R · the switch

tts_sentences.text_en: It's all yours — charge the plates, throw the switch to release them, add resistance, and reshape the whole rhythm by dragging inductance and capacitance.

assessment.mastery_definition: A student has mastered LC oscillations when they can (1) explain that with the source physically removed, a charged capacitor and inductor exchange energy forever (ideally) at the circuit's OWN natural frequency omega0 = 1/sqrt(LC), never a source-imposed one; (2) explain why the current is MAXIMUM exactly when the charge is zero — the coil's inertia keeps a flowing current from stopping, recharging the plates with reversed polarity; (3) compute the peak current from energy conservation, 1/2 C V0^2 = 1/2 L I0^2, and identify the quarter-cycle phase relationship between charge and current; (4) explain that the stored energy only changes ADDRESS between the capacitor's electric field and the inductor's magnetic field, with the total conserved exactly and never spent, in an ideal (resistance-free) loop; (5) state the exact mechanical correspondence (charge <-> displacement, current <-> velocity, inductance <-> mass, reciprocal capacitance <-> spring constant) and explain why inductance plays the role of mass; and (6) explain that real resistance is what makes a real LC oscillation decay, dissipating the stored energy as heat, and that sustaining a swing forever requires a periodic push at the circuit's own natural frequency.

questions.stem: In this free LC circuit, at the instant the capacitor's charge reaches exactly zero, what is the current?

options.A: The current is at its own maximum value (2.00 A here) — the coil's inertia keeps driving it exactly when the charge is zero
options.B: The current is exactly zero too, since there's no more charge left to push it
options.C: The current becomes undefined, since nothing is left to measure
options.D: The current instantly reverses direction and stays at zero briefly before restarting

distractor_misconceptions.B: This is the confronted misconception — the coil's own inertia keeps current flowing exactly when the charge, not the current, is zero; charge and current are a quarter cycle apart, never zero together
distractor_misconceptions.C: Current is a perfectly well-defined, measurable quantity at every instant of a continuous oscillation — nothing about zero charge makes it undefined
distractor_misconceptions.D: The current doesn't briefly vanish and restart — it passes smoothly through its own peak magnitude at this exact instant, in one direction

questions.tested_idea: In an undriven LC oscillation, current and charge are 90 degrees out of phase — current is maximum exactly when charge is zero, never zero together.
questions.parallel_form_stem: At the instant the current is exactly zero, what is true about the charge on the plates?

questions.stem: A capacitor of 0.1273 F is charged to 10.0 V and then connected to a 3.1831 H inductor with no resistance. How do you find the peak current?

options.A: Set the initial capacitor energy equal to the peak inductor energy, 1/2 C V0^2 = 1/2 L I0^2, and solve for I0 — giving 2.00 A
options.B: Divide the peak voltage by some resistance value, I0 = V0/R, the same way you would for a steady DC circuit
options.C: Multiply the capacitance by the inductance directly, I0 = C times L times V0
options.D: The peak current cannot be found without knowing how long the circuit has been oscillating

distractor_misconceptions.B: There is no resistance in this ideal loop to divide by — that is a DC-circuit habit; the correct route is energy conservation between the two energy-storing elements, not Ohm's law
distractor_misconceptions.C: This invents a formula with no physical basis — capacitance and inductance don't combine by simple multiplication with voltage to give current
distractor_misconceptions.D: The peak current is a fixed property of the circuit (set entirely by V0, L, and C through energy conservation) and does not depend on elapsed time — it recurs every cycle

questions.tested_idea: The peak current in a free LC oscillation follows directly from equating the initial stored electric energy to the peak magnetic energy: 1/2 C V0^2 = 1/2 L I0^2.
questions.parallel_form_stem: If the capacitance were doubled while V0 and L stayed the same, would the peak current increase or decrease?

questions.stem: What determines the frequency at which a source-free LC circuit oscillates?

options.A: Only the inductance and capacitance, f0 = 1/(2 pi sqrt(LC)) — the initial charging voltage has no effect on the frequency at all
options.B: The initial voltage the capacitor was charged to — a bigger starting voltage swings faster
options.C: The physical size of the wires connecting the components
options.D: The frequency changes randomly from one cycle to the next since there's no source to fix it

distractor_misconceptions.B: This is the confronted misconception — amplitude (set by V0) and frequency (set by L and C alone) are independent; a bigger starting voltage makes a bigger swing at the exact same rhythm, never a faster one
distractor_misconceptions.C: Wire size affects negligible practical resistance, not the ideal L and C values that set the natural frequency
distractor_misconceptions.D: The oscillation is a strict, repeatable mathematical consequence of L and C — it recurs at the exact same frequency every single cycle, with no randomness

questions.tested_idea: The natural frequency of a free LC oscillation depends only on L and C (f0 = 1/(2 pi sqrt(LC))); it never depends on the initial voltage or charge.
questions.parallel_form_stem: If the same circuit were charged to 20.0 V instead of 10.0 V, would the oscillation frequency change?

questions.stem: In an ideal (resistance-free) LC circuit that has been oscillating for many cycles, what is true of the total stored energy, and how long after a fully-electric instant is the energy entirely magnetic?

options.A: The total energy stays exactly constant forever, and the energy becomes entirely magnetic exactly a quarter period after being entirely electric
options.B: The total energy gradually converts to heat and shrinks toward zero, even with no resistance present, because every real oscillation must eventually run down
options.C: The total energy doubles every cycle since both the capacitor and the inductor are adding energy to the circuit
options.D: The energy becomes entirely magnetic only after a full period has passed, not a quarter period

distractor_misconceptions.B: This is the confronted misconception — with zero resistance there is no pathway for energy to leave as heat at all; the total is exactly conserved forever (STATE_7 is what happens only once real resistance is added)
distractor_misconceptions.C: Neither element ADDS energy — they only exchange the same fixed total back and forth; the total set at the very first charging event never grows
distractor_misconceptions.D: The capacitor and inductor exchange the stored energy completely twice per full cycle, so the energy is entirely magnetic a quarter period, not a full period, after being entirely electric

questions.tested_idea: In an ideal LC loop, total stored energy is exactly conserved forever, and it is entirely magnetic exactly T0/4 after being entirely electric — energy exchanges twice per cycle.
questions.parallel_form_stem: How long after the energy is entirely magnetic will it next be entirely electric again?

questions.stem: In the mechanical (mass-on-a-spring) analogy for this LC circuit, what plays the role of the mass?

options.A: The inductor L — it resists changes in current the same way mass resists changes in velocity (inertia)
options.B: The capacitor's reciprocal capacitance, 1/C — since it 'pushes back' the way a spring does
options.C: The resistor R, since it's the only element that visibly interacts with the circuit's motion
options.D: The peak voltage V0, since it sets how big the whole oscillation is

distractor_misconceptions.B: 1/C plays the role of the SPRING CONSTANT, not the mass — a bigger 1/C (smaller capacitance) makes a stiffer 'spring', by direct analogy with x -> q
distractor_misconceptions.C: R has no role in the ideal (undamped) analogy at all — it only enters once real resistance is added, and even then it plays the role of mechanical friction, not the mass
distractor_misconceptions.D: V0 sets the amplitude of the swing (like how hard you pull back a real spring), not which component behaves like mass

questions.tested_idea: In the LC-spring/mass correspondence, inductance L plays the role of mass — it is what resists CHANGE in current, mirroring how mass resists change in velocity.
questions.parallel_form_stem: In this same analogy, what mechanical quantity does the reciprocal capacitance 1/C correspond to?

questions.stem: Why does a real LC circuit's oscillation gradually die away, and what would it take to keep it swinging forever?

options.A: Real coils have some resistance, which drains energy away as heat every cycle; keeping the swing going forever requires something to push the circuit at its own natural rhythm, replacing exactly what the resistance leaks
options.B: The capacitor physically wears out over time and loses its ability to hold charge
options.C: The oscillation dies because the inductor eventually runs out of magnetic field to store
options.D: Real LC circuits don't actually decay — this only happens in flawed simulations, not in reality

distractor_misconceptions.B: The capacitor itself does not wear out in this decay — the energy loss comes from real resistance in the coil's wire converting circuit energy into heat, not from any material degrading
distractor_misconceptions.C: The inductor doesn't run out of anything to store — it can hold magnetic energy proportional to the current at any instant; the decay comes from resistance bleeding energy away as heat, not from any storage limit
distractor_misconceptions.D: This decay is genuine, real physics — every real coil has some resistance, and that resistance dissipates energy every single cycle in any physical LC circuit

questions.tested_idea: Real LC oscillations decay because real coils carry resistance that dissipates energy as heat every cycle; sustaining an oscillation forever requires a periodic push at the circuit's own natural frequency.
questions.parallel_form_stem: If the resistance in this circuit were doubled, would the oscillation decay faster or slower?
